scope: Bounded JSON shape and input-size validation for POST /auth/login

criteria.description: The authentication route casts arbitrary parsed JSON to LoginRequest and reads payload.username before establishing an object boundary; username/password are not bounded at the HTTP boundary.
criteria.limitations: Source-level selection evidence; dedicated RED remains required.

criteria.description: The smallest safe correction is a route-local LoginRequest validator after the existing rate-limit check and before AuthService.login, preserving response/cookie behavior and excluding MFA/session redesign.
criteria.limitations: No account UUID policy or email-login behavior is authorized by this gate.

criteria.description: Focused route tests can prove non-object JSON and oversized credential fields return sanitized 400 responses without invoking authentication, while existing success and rate-limit tests remain compatible.
criteria.limitations: Fresh RED/GREEN and affected regression remain pending.

gaps: The intentional route RED, implementation, regression, quality and review are not complete at gate creation.
conditions: Validate before AuthService.login without moving rate limiting after credential validation.
Do not echo invalid fields or alter the global ERP non-promotion state.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via fresh local residual scouting after the bounded semantic PIX replay closure
authority.decision: Authorize reversible route/helper/test changes for JSON object validation and maximum lengths only. Exclude email-login expansion, MFA/session/WebAuthn changes, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, release and global ERP promotion.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing login identity semantics, MFA/session policy, account ID format, rate-limit policy or any target/production behavior.

revalidation_triggers: Adding email login or changing username canonicalization
Changing password hashing or MFA challenge semantics
Changing the auth rate-limit ordering or distributed backend
Any provider, target, production, deployment or release operation
next_action: Write and run the intentional RED before changing auth-routes implementation.
